issue_context.title: roachtest: psycopg failed
issue_context.body:
SHA: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/commits/1c3fce73cd25fa69e5a8c05ce8e215d66b4f49e4

Parameters:

To repro, try:

```
# Don't forget to check out a clean suitable branch and experiment with the
# stress invocation until the desired results present themselves. For example,
# using stress instead of stressrace and passing the '-p' stressflag which
# controls concurrency.
./scripts/gceworker.sh start && ./scripts/gceworker.sh mosh
cd ~/go/src/github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach && \
stdbuf -oL -eL \
make stressrace TESTS=psycopg PKG=roachtest TESTTIMEOUT=5m STRESSFLAGS='-maxtime 20m -timeout 10m' 2>&1 | tee /tmp/stress.log
```
